name: App Store & Google Play Store Intelligence
description: Programmatically query top charts, search results, trending feeds, and detailed store metadata for Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
longDescription: A robust, lightweight API for querying app charts, search, trending, and detailed metadata (rating, ratingCount, price, in-app purchases, category, size, releaseDate, icon) from Apple App Store and Google Play Store. It features optimized iTunes API batch resolutions and JSON-LD Google Play Store crawlers. Routes all request traffic through rotated mobile carrier proxies (4G/5G) and integrates the x402 payment validation flow.
